# assignmentB2AndresOcampo

`assignmentB2AndresOcampo` provides a single convenient function,
`count_all_missing_by_group()`, that counts the number of missing values
in every column of a data frame, grouped by a variable of your choice.

## Installation

You can install the development version from GitHub with:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("AndresOcampo29/assignmentB2AndresOcampo", ref = "0.1.0")
```

## Usage

Count missing values in `airquality` grouped by `Month`:

```{r}
library(assignmentB2AndresOcampo)
count_all_missing_by_group(airquality, Month)
```

You can also pipe the data in:

```{r}
airquality |> count_all_missing_by_group(Month)
```

Use `.groups = "keep"` to keep the result grouped:

```{r}
count_all_missing_by_group(airquality, Month, .groups = "keep")
```
